description:
Upload files to Clueso. Pick a mode by client and where the file lives:
- `files` (ChatGPT only): the user's attachments, filled by ChatGPT; pass them instead of asking for a re-upload.
- `file_name` (default for agents/scripts: Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop): returns an upload URL on Clueso's own domain (not S3; works where cloud storage is blocked) + a ready curl that PUTs one local file; you or the user run it.
- `file_names` (without request_hosted_upload): the same for many files, one token + URL each and ONE curl for all; run it from the folder the names are relative to (edit_animation upload_ids: the page site's root, e.g. 'index.html', 'js/scene.js').
- `file_url`: a public https URL; the server fetches it; mcp_upload_id returned at once.
- `request_hosted_upload` (only when a human should pick files in a browser, or no shell/PUT): one upload_token + upload_page link covering every file dropped; the user drops files and clicks Done; then check_uploads(upload_token). Call once for all files.

The mcp_upload_id (`mup_…`) goes to:
- add_elements / update_elements: an image/video ON a clip (or a source swap) as `type_data.mcp_upload_id`; an animation's image slot inside `type_data.parameter_values` on update_elements only (stripped on add).
- add_audio (project music track) · add_clips(kind='video') (video/audio → clip with transcription) · add_clips(kind='pptx') · add_article_media · analyze_audio · edit_animation (`files: [{path, upload_id}]` or `upload_ids` named by path, so big files never go inline).

purpose: 'font' (any mode; display_name optional) adds it to this workspace's brand fonts once it arrives: the curl's reply (this reply for file_url/files, check_uploads for the hosted page) carries `font: {name, family, format, converted_from}` or `font_error`. TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 (WOFF/WOFF2 stored as TTF). Name = display_name, else the family without build dates/versions ("Cursor Mono 260406" → "Cursor Mono"); use it exactly in font_setting.font and pages. One face per name; an existing name is refused. Needs editor/admin and a plan with custom fonts.

display_name.description: With purpose 'font' and one file (file_name, file_url, one files entry, or one file_names entry): the name to list the font under. Default: its family name without build dates or versions.

file_name.description: File name with extension. Returns a Clueso upload URL + curl command that streams this single local file to us (single file).

file_names.description: Hosted mode: the file names the user will upload, shown on the page. Without request_hosted_upload: upload these local files in one call (one token + URL each, and one curl for all), max 50.

file_url.description: Public URL to fetch the file from

files.description: ChatGPT file attachments, one entry per file (filled by ChatGPT).

download_url.description: Temporary download URL supplied by ChatGPT

purpose.description: 'font': add the file to this workspace's brand fonts once it arrives (see above). With request_hosted_upload, every file dropped on the page is one, reported by check_uploads.

request_hosted_upload.description: If true, returns a hosted upload page. Call once for all files — the page accepts multiple uploads under one token.

name: upload_file
title: Upload file
